description: Build the evidence layer for routing: a frozen role-fitness corpus judged by each role's own gate, evaluation across both model and role-prompt variant, a candidate intake with a scheduled frontier watch, and a periodic routing proposal that a human approves. No component may write to a role pool.

sprint.goal: Stop tracking the global frontier and start measuring role fitness on a schedule, so a new model release becomes evidence rather than an interruption, and routing changes stay a human decision.

stories.title: Candidate intake and scheduled frontier watch
